outcome: Obstetric outcomes (e.g., gestational age at delivery, live births, stillbirths)
Surgical details (e.g., curettage, hysterotomy, cesarean section)
Application and evaluation of a surgical and radiologic algorithm
cohort: 58 pregnant patients affected by the Kahramanmaras Earthquake who were admitted to or referred to a tertiary hospital's obstetrics and gynecology emergency department between February 6 and March 6, 2023.
finding: Ultrasound is the primary diagnostic tool for emergency evaluation in pregnant women, and specific surgical approaches like midline incisions and intraoperative evaluations are recommended for trauma-affected pregnant earthquake victims, as they can be life-saving for both mother and baby.
mod_finding: Out of 11 deliveries, 2 were vaginal deliveries and 9 were cesarean sections.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at evaluation was 22.24 ± 10.59 weeks; mean gestational age at delivery was 32.81 weeks.
